title: CoinGecko Trending Coins
description: Captures the top trending coins on CoinGecko - these are the tokens seeing the biggest surge in search interest across the platform. Trending coins often precede price moves by 12-48 hours as retail attention builds before volume follows. Also captures trending NFTs and categories for broader market sentiment.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3'
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/search/trending', timeout=30)
resp.raise_for_status()
data = resp.json()

rows = []

# Trending coins
for item in data.get('coins', []):
    c = item.get('item', {})
    price_data = c.get('data', {})
    rows.append({
        'type': 'coin',
        'trend_rank': c.get('score', 0) + 1,
        'coin_id': c.get('id', ''),
        'symbol': str(c.get('symbol', '')).upper(),
        'name': c.get('name', ''),
        'market_cap_rank': c.get('market_cap_rank', 0),
        'price_usd': float(price_data.get('price', 0) or 0),
        'change_24h_pct': float(price_data.get('price_change_percentage_24h', {}).get('usd', 0) or 0),
        'market_cap': float(str(price_data.get('market_cap', '0')).replace(',', '').replace('$', '') or 0) if price_data.get('market_cap') else 0.0,
        'total_volume': float(str(price_data.get('total_volume', '0')).replace(',', '').replace('$', '') or 0) if price_data.get('total_volume') else 0.0,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

# Trending NFTs
for nft in data.get('nfts', []):
    nft_data = nft.get('data', {})
    rows.append({
        'type': 'nft',
        'trend_rank': 0,
        'coin_id': nft.get('id', ''),
        'symbol': str(nft.get('symbol', '')).upper(),
        'name': nft.get('name', ''),
        'market_cap_rank': 0,
        'price_usd': 0.0,
        'change_24h_pct': float(str(nft_data.get('floor_price_in_usd_24h_percentage_change', '0') or '0')),
        'market_cap': 0.0,
        'total_volume': 0.0,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

# Trending categories
for cat in data.get('categories', []):
    cat_data = cat.get('data', {})
    rows.append({
        'type': 'category',
        'trend_rank': 0,
        'coin_id': str(cat.get('id', '')),
        'symbol': '',
        'name': cat.get('name', ''),
        'market_cap_rank': 0,
        'price_usd': 0.0,
        'change_24h_pct': float(cat_data.get('market_cap_change_percentage_24h', {}).get('usd', 0) or 0),
        'market_cap': float(cat_data.get('market_cap', 0) or 0),
        'total_volume': float(cat_data.get('total_volume', 0) or 0),
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
